typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Contact as string,
		{Contact Type} as string,
		{Access Request Id} as string,
		Status as string,
		Accessibility as string,
		{Start Date} as timestamp,
		{End Date} as timestamp,
		Requestor as string,
		{Request Date} as timestamp,
		Notes as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		ContactType as string,
		AccessRequestId as string,
		Accessibility as string,
		EndDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FName as string,
		Contact as string,
		StartDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EtlUser as string,
		RequestDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Requestor as string,
		Notes as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		UploadDate,
		ContactType = {Contact Type},
		AccessRequestId = {Access Request Id},
		Accessibility,
		EndDate = {End Date},
		FName,
		Contact,
		StartDate = {Start Date},
		EtlUser,
		RequestDate = {Request Date},
		Requestor,
		Notes),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
